title: Improved electrical and bioactivities of lead-free BNT–SBT ceramics by STZ additive and post-sintering processes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4228-4240
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07450A, Paper

Kamonporn Saenkam, Waraporn Boontakam, Phanrawee Sriprapha, Pichitchai Butnoi, Kamonpan Pengpat, Chamnan Randorn, Gobwute Rujijanagul
This study investigates the effects of Sr(Ti0.85Zr0.15)O3 (STZ) additive and post-sintering treatments on the electrical and biological properties of lead-free (1 − x)[0.7(Bi0.5Na0.5)TiO3–0.3(Sr0.7Bi0.2)TiO3]–xSTZ ceramics.
